about: Outfit recipes: region -> fill. A fill is a colour, a short description (see outfit/prompts.py) or a dict ({"pattern": ..., "colors": [primary, secondary], "scale": metres per repeat, "rotation": degrees}). Regions left out keep the avatar's own clothes.
